This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.3503 of 2025, pending before the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Vth Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division), Dehradun, under Sections 323, 498A, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,
Section 3 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Vth Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division), Dehradun
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr. Rajendra Singh Azad, learned counsel (through video conferencing) for the applicant and Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for the respondent no.1.
3.
Mr. Rajendra Singh Azad, learned counsel for the applicant, the husband of the respondent no.2-informant submitted that the allegations of the respondent no.2 are totally false.
4. Notice is being issued to the respondent no.2.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till then, the further proceedings of Criminal Case No.3503 of 2025 are stayed.

6. The applicant and the respondent no.2 are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 03.11.2025 at 10.30 a.m. (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 26.09.2025 JKJ/Pant C528/1738/2025 on 26 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93196348/
